items.exampleEn: Living alone on the island, he felt a sense of isolation.
items.exampleZh: 他獨自住在島上，感到很孤立。

items.exampleEn: Many teenagers are socially active online.
items.exampleZh: 很多青少年在網路上的社交很活躍。

items.exampleEn: Slavery was common in many ancient civilizations.
items.exampleZh: 奴隸制度在許多古代文明中很普遍。

items.exampleEn: The group works for equality between men and women.
items.exampleZh: 這個團體為男女平等而努力。

items.exampleEn: The rain was a blessing for the farmers.
items.exampleZh: 這場雨對農夫來說是一種恩賜。

items.exampleEn: The old bookshop was a popular haunt of young writers.
items.exampleZh: 那家老書店是年輕作家常去的地方。

items.exampleEn: The monks get up at four every morning.
items.exampleZh: 僧侶們每天早上四點起床。

items.exampleEn: The liberation of the birds from their cages made the children cheer.
items.exampleZh: 鳥兒從籠子裡被放出來，孩子們歡呼起來。

items.sentenceEn: Equality is important in our school.
items.sentenceZh: 平等在我們學校很重要。

items.audioEn: The monks are having a quiet morning, so visitors can only enter after lunch.
items.audioZh: 僧侶們早上要靜修，所以遊客只能在午餐後進入。
items.questionZh: 遊客什麼時候可以進去？

items.sentenceZh: 僧侶常常過著簡單的生活。

items.sentenceEn: Slavery is against the law in every country today.
items.sentenceZh: 如今每個國家都禁止奴隸制度。

items.stemEn: In our club, everyone has the same vote, so there is real ____ between members.
items.stemZh: 我們社團每個人都有一樣的投票權，所以會員之間真的很平等。

items.stemEn: She hasn't gone out ____ very much since she started working from home.
items.stemZh: 自從開始在家工作，她就很少出門社交。

items.passageEn: Last summer, my uncle stayed at a mountain temple for a week. The monks there live in isolation, far from the city. They don't use phones, and they rarely meet people socially. My uncle said that it was hard at first, but later it felt like liberation from his busy life. The monks told him that every simple meal is a blessing. Now the quiet temple has become one of his favorite haunts. In the temple's small library, he also read old books about history, including the end of slavery in many countries and the long fight for equality.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我叔叔在一座山上的寺廟住了一個星期。那裡的僧侶過著與世隔絕的生活，遠離城市。他們不用手機，也很少和人社交往來。叔叔說，一開始很難熬，但後來感覺像是從忙碌的生活中解放了。僧侶們告訴他，每一頓簡單的飯都是一種恩賜。現在那座安靜的寺廟成了他最常去的地方之一。在寺廟的小圖書館裡，他也讀了一些歷史舊書，包括許多國家廢除奴隸制度，以及爭取平等的漫長過程。

questions.questionZh: 那裡的僧侶過著什麼樣的生活？
options: 每天在城裡教小朋友讀書
常常出國參加各種活動

questions.questionZh: 叔叔現在怎麼看那座寺廟？

referenceEn: Having good friends is a blessing.
rubricZh: blessing 表示「恩賜、福氣」，可數名詞，例如 a blessing 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 haunt 造一個句子，說說你最常去的地方。
referenceEn: The library near my home is my favorite haunt.
This park was my favorite haunt when I was a child.
rubricZh: haunt 表示「常去的地方」，例如 my favorite haunt 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 my）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式、過去式等）
